title: Drottningholm Palace, main building and connected courtyard wings
visualBrief: Connected mapped exterior of Drottningholm Palace: pale-yellow rendered three-story central block, cream pilasters/window surrounds/arched lake-side ground openings, green-gray hipped central roof and raised roof pavilions, low courtyard wings, four intermediate pavilions, northern chapel dome and matching southern domed end. Preserve both mapped open courtyards and all independent theater/outbuildings. One actual recessed lake-side central doorway and simple threshold. No furnished rooms, copied coats of arms, flag graphics, statues or garden reconstruction.

sourceFacts.horizontalBasis: Q208559 and named palace POI on relation3182815/native52776561316063 identify one connected courtyard palace. Own this parent only. Heading0; native east/south geometry has the signed axes baked in. Original outer ring and two courtyard holes determine occupied floors and replacement. The detached theater way23519174 and other pavilions remain independent map context.
